name: meridian/loanapp
description: Meridian Trust Financial loan origination system (LoanApp). Composer manifest added by Bluewater Consulting for the lib/ modernization layer; never installed.

scripts.lint: find lib public includes partner tools -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l

meridian.status: NOT INSTALLED. There is no vendor/ directory and no composer.lock, deliberately: the origination box has no outbound network access and no PHP package manager, and getting one approved was out of scope for the engagement. Every script above is therefore aspirational. The autoload block is duplicated by hand in lib/autoload.php, which is also not registered.
